_comment: Manual overrides per species, keyed by scientific name: {"include": [inat photo ids, forced in first, in this order], "exclude": [inat photo ids never chosen], "description": {"summary", "field_marks", "size", "habitat": text written over the Wikipedia-derived fields}, "limit": N cleared candidates to consider instead of the build's --limit, "trust_article": true to take a Wikipedia article whose lead names neither the BirdNET binomial nor the BirdNET common name, "sounds": {"song": "xc-<nr>", "call": "xc-<nr>" pinned first, "exclude": [recording ids never chosen], "xeno_canto_name": the name xeno-canto files the species under, "accept": [species BirdNET may hear instead, the other half of a split]}}. Photo ids are in the pack's report.json and LICENSE.
